status: Two new skill presentation candidates; in-game visual review and device listening pending
author: Original Shu procedural skill mesh and audio presentation
implementation: Compatibility-friendly ArrayMesh ribbons from actual blade base/tip samples; no particle-trail addon or copied third-party effect

skills.pierce: Narrow forward gold/white ribbon flies during strike .24-.34s, covers the full stage-supplied legal endpoint at impact, then leaves a fading retreating tail and six linear glints
skills.sweep: Continuous 25-point 132-degree 1.56m front ribbon with shared camera-facing tangent widths and smoothly tapered alpha; raised wider white core and eight brief ground accents; normal depth test retained

api.setup: setup(muted=false, volume_db=-10.0) -> {ok,reason}; add helper under world before attack
api.begin: begin_attack(skill_id, from, to, blade_base, blade_tip); all supplied positions are global
api.clock: Stage calls update_blade(base,tip), then step(delta); helper has no self-ticking process/timer
api.impact: impact() is idempotent per attack; Stage owns the gameplay hit time
api.cleanup: cancel() stops and frees all transient meshes/audio nodes; finished audio emitters queue their own deletion after callback
api.audio: set_audio(muted,volume_db); muted calls do not play or increment audio_play_count; history records actual play() calls, not device audibility

validation_boundary: Isolated headless checks decode WAVs and verify mesh shape, global input conversion, bounded lifetimes, idempotency and audio play calls. They do not establish in-game aesthetics, Web performance, device sound or user acceptance.
